These files were generated by us: the `.wmf` files are recorded with Windows GDI calls from synthetic drawings (placeable files, and `_nonplaceable` copies with the placeable header removed), and each `_wmf_gdi_256x256.png` is what Windows GDI `PlayMetaFile` drew for the placeable file into a white 32-bit bitmap of 256 x 256 pixels (Windows 11, 150% display scaling). They contain no third-party content. The rendering tests compare the vector output with them.
